efficientnetv2b0_clahe_256.input: 256x256 RGB, raw 0-255 after CLAHE (rescaling and ImageNet normalization inside the model)
efficientnetv2b0_clahe_256.evaluation: 1,440-image held-out split (360 per class); random per-image split, no patient IDs, no external validation

deeplabv3plus.evaluation: LGG MRI segmentation dataset, patient-grouped split
deeplabv3plus.xai: Seg-Grad-CAM (target = sum of predicted tumor probability)

unet3d_brats.input: 96x96x64x4 patches (FLAIR, T1, T1CE, T2), sliding window stride 64x64x32
unet3d_brats.evaluation: BraTS2020, patient-level split, complete-volume sliding-window evaluation on 56 held-out patients
unet3d_brats.comparison_note: The 2D Attention CNN + ViT whole-tumor Dice of 0.8937 used selected tumor-enriched slices; the protocols differ, so the numbers are not a head-to-head comparison.
unet3d_brats.use: Research baseline; no external or clinical validation.
